title: feat(retry): add configurable delay and retry limits
author: dannycreations
lessons: Removing exponential backoff is a regression, not a simplification -- keep proven strategies as defaults
Tests that re-implement production logic are tautological -- test the actual code paths
0 = unlimited is a UX anti-pattern for numeric slider controls -- use checkbox + conditional input
Default value changes (5s to 10s) affect all existing installations and need migration awareness
